info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, swellAngle, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, loopWidth, loopXglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDListon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 50  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  swellAngle = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos    swellAngle = swellAngle + 2    if swellAngle > 360 then      swellAngle = swellAngle - 360    end if    this.locV = Ypos + (10 * cos(swellAngle * radians))  end ifend
info.name: Ship
